resolved_issues.issue: MongoDB aggregation error with $substr operation on UTF-8 characters causing 520 responses
resolved_issues.fix_applied: Replaced MongoDB $substr with Python string truncation to safely handle UTF-8 characters

minor_issues.impact: Minor - expected behavior for modal UX, doesn't affect functionality
